reasoning.Student A:
My goal is to maximize my chances of getting my most preferred school from my obtainable set. My preference order is w > x > z > y.

School w: I have top priority (1). This means w is always in my obtainable set, regardless of how I rank the other schools. Therefore, I should rank w first.

School x: I have priority 2. It is possible that I might get x, but only if w is full or if other applicants with higher priority at x choose other schools.

School y: I have top priority (1). This means y is always in my obtainable set, regardless of how I rank the other schools.

School z: I have priority 2. It is possible that I might get z, but only if w and x are full or if other applicants with higher priority at z choose other schools.

Since w is my most preferred and is always obtainable, I rank it first. Now I need to decide the order of the remaining schools. My preference is x > z > y. Since I know y is always obtainable, I should only rank it higher than z if I want to end up at y rather than z. Since I prefer z to y, I should rank z higher than y. Similarly, I prefer x to z, so I should rank x higher than z.

Therefore, my ranking should be w > x > z > y. This ensures that I get w if possible. If w is not possible, I will get x if it is available. If neither w nor x are available, I will get z if it is available. Only if none of w, x, or z are available will I end up at y, which I know is always obtainable.

School z also has the highest priority for me (rank 1). I like z better than y and x, and worse than w. So if I can get z, that would be a good outcome.

School w has priority rank 2 for me. I like w the best, so I want to include it in my ranking.

School y has priority rank 2 for me. I like y better than x but worse than w and z.

Since x is guaranteed to be obtainable, I need to rank the other schools in my preference order to maximize my chances of getting a better school than x.

Therefore, I should rank the schools in my true preference order: w > z > y > x. This ensures that if w, z, or y are also obtainable, I will be matched with the best of the obtainable set.
